digest.component_or_area: plan-review health rendering and validation surfaces
propositions: Plan-material-pin health metrics (drift, enforcement, phase compatibility) must be exposed in detailed review surfaces (CLI show, MCP ticket detail, audit output, close errors, web review UI) without adding noise to list output or persisting warning events.

All detailed renderers must consume the DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract and display canonical related tickets, fingerprint status, missing-target state, enforcement effect, and phase metadata using unified derived health semantics.
When pin enforcement is disabled, observed drift must be labeled advisory; legacy-unpinned and current-no-relationships states must be visibly distinguished from active invalidity.
Audit rendering must call compute_validity and handle missing attestation, unexpected output, timeout, or exception at the build_context boundary without changing audit_trail never-raise behavior.
Output schemas and golden-path tests must be updated to include plan_review_health in detailed output while keeping ordinary list output and stored ticket events unchanged.
